name: Board & Dice of the World
subtitle: Dara, Mangala, Generala & more
shortDescription: 11 board, sowing, hunt and dice games to play: Dara, Omweso, Mangala and Mongolian chess.
longDescription:
Board & Dice of the World: 11 board, sowing, hunt and dice games from 15 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Dara, Omweso, Mangala, Mongolian chess, Shisima, Kaooa, Hounds and Jackals, Generala, Ship, Captain and Crew, Ten Thousand and Mia.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can play the computer or a friend at sowing, hunt, line and chess-family board games, throw and keep dice in cup games, and bluff a rival at Mia, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
